candidate_sentence_map.S1: WindowMaster International A/S reported a decline in financial performance for the fiscal year 2025 compared to 2024, primarily driven by a slowdown in revenue generation.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Total revenue amounted to DKK 268.6 million, representing an 8% decrease from DKK 294.5 million in the previous year.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: This contraction was attributed to a slow start to the year and reduced sales to a key customer in the Nordic region, as well as lower growth in North America.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Despite the lower top line, the company achieved an improved gross profit margin of 48.8% in 2025, up from 46.9% in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: The margin expansion was linked to a favorable business mix, characterized by less revenue from key accounts and more direct project revenue, which aligns with the company’s "Accelerate Core" strategy.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Operating profit (EBITDA) fell to DKK 28.0 million from DKK 37.3 million in 2024, resulting in an EBITDA margin of 10.4% compared to 12.7% previously.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: The decline in operating profitability was primarily due to maintained fixed cost levels intended to support future growth, coupled with a DKK 2.5 million one-off expense incurred from a ransomware attack on the company’s IT infrastructure in May and June 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Consequently, profit before tax dropped to DKK 2.9 million from DKK 12.2 million, and profit after tax decreased significantly to DKK 0.9 million from DKK 10.6 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: The high effective tax rate of 70% in 2025 was driven by the non-utilization of tax loss carryforwards.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Cash flow from operating activities remained robust at DKK 28.5 million, slightly down from DKK 29.4 million in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: The company successfully improved net working capital, which decreased to DKK 31.9 million from DKK 35.0 million, primarily through better management of inventories and work in progress.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: Cash flow from investing activities was DKK -9.4 million, reflecting investments in digitalization, software development, and IT security upgrades, including the firewall enhancements necessitated by the ransomware incident.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Net interest-bearing debt increased to DKK 38.7 million from DKK 36.7 million, leading to a financial gearing ratio of 1.7, up from 1.2 in 2024, though still within the target of below 2.0.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Equity decreased to DKK 32.5 million, resulting in an equity ratio of 23.5%, slightly below the 25% target.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Looking ahead, WindowMaster expects market conditions to improve in 2026, driven by stabilized interest rates and ongoing demand for energy-efficient building solutions.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: The company has set a revenue growth target of 7% to 14% for 2026, aiming for revenue between DKK 290 million and DKK 310 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Management anticipates that EBITDA will increase to between DKK 45 million and DKK 55 million, corresponding to an EBITDA margin of 8% to 10%.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: This projected profitability improvement is expected to be driven by operating leverage, as top-line growth requires only minor increases in the fixed cost base.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: The company remains confident in its long-term growth opportunities despite short-term uncertainties related to geopolitical developments and supply chain constraints.

evaluation.label: Generally yes
